current_activity: command post at Wenzenbach, just northeast of Regensburg, as the division crosses the Danube east of the city
notes: Event date: 25 April 1945 (CMH ETO-OB command-post list of the 71st Infantry Division: Wenzenbach on 25 Apr 45; Last Offensive ch. 18 p. 426: cavalry gained the Danube southwest of Regensburg early in the afternoon of 24 April and opened the way for assault crossings by the 65th and 71st Divisions "the following night"; p. 435: the 65th and 71st Divisions of the XX Corps crossed on either side of Regensburg). Event definition: the division command post is on the north bank of the Danube, northeast of Regensburg, on the day after the crossing night. Relationship: XX Corps unspecified_subordination (from 20 Apr 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 8 Apr 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 29 Mar 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Wenzenbach (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R574 p. 228: listed 25 April 1945); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Wenzenbach. Event support: moderate (one Green Book chapter, two pages, and the CMH table). Location support: moderate (command post listed on the date). Review (26 October 2026, found while adding this row): p. 426 says "the following night" after the afternoon of 24 April, which is the night of 24 to 25 April or of 25 to 26 April; the Green Book gives no date for the crossing itself, so none is recorded and the row is the command post of 25 April.
